purpose: Teach: 育毛/素顔/投球/真珠/灯油/ゾウ/主食/鯛

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが育毛のシャンプー買ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad bought some of that hair-growth shampoo again.
lines.style: Gentle, matter-of-fact observation. Slight warmth — not mocking, just noticing. Conversational exhale. The tone of a mother sharing a small domestic detail without judgment.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、ママの素顔が一番好きだよ
lines.en: Mom, I like your face best — the way it really is.
lines.style: Sincere and direct, the way only small children can be. No hesitation. Soft eye contact. The words land like a gift he doesn't know he's giving.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんと公園で投球練習しましょうね
lines.en: Sho, why don't you go practice throwing with Dad at the park.
lines.style: Warm suggestion, not a command. Slight lift at the end — inviting rather than directing. The kind of gentle redirect a mother uses when she's thinking of two people at once.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祖母ちゃんが真珠の指輪を見せてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, Grandma showed me her pearl ring today.
lines.style: Bright and open, eager to share a small treasure. Natural child-pace, no rush. The delight of having noticed something beautiful and wanting to tell her about it.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが灯油の補給に行ってらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, your dad went out to refill the kerosene.
lines.style: Quiet domestic note, almost to herself. Practical tone. The kind of small announcement mothers make when they're keeping track of household rhythms.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、動物園で大きなゾウさんに会ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I saw a huge elephant at the zoo today!
lines.style: Bubbling with excitement, the words tumbling out. Bright eyes. Quick pace. The uncontainable joy of a six-year-old who encountered something magnificent.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、ご飯を主食にしてバランスよく食べましょう
lines.en: Sho, make sure you eat rice as your main and balance out your meals.
lines.style: Gentle instruction, caring not controlling. Steady, matter-of-fact rhythm. The voice of a mother who knows nutrition matters and delivers wisdom without weight.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、お祝いの日にお祖母ちゃんが鯛を焼いてくれたよ
lines.en: Mom, on my birthday Grandma grilled sea bream for us.
lines.style: Warm memory-voice, pride and affection mixed. Slower than the elephant line — savoring the detail. The kind of precious small moment a child holds onto and wants to preserve by telling.
